Name: Valley Alive
Author: StaRzZz91
Description:
Valley Alive
[b]Valley Alive[/b] adds a new community event system to Stardew Valley, giving Pelican Town more life, activity, and long-term progression.
Help with rotating town events, earn Community Tokens, build your reputation, unlock badges, and spend your rewards in a large progressive Reward Shop.
[heading]What Does This Mod Add?[/heading]
Valley Alive adds a custom town event board where you can view the current community event, track progress, see rewards, check your reputation, browse badges, view event history, and open the Reward Shop.
Events can involve helping the town, gathering supplies, supporting villagers, visiting locations, or taking part in special community moments.
[heading]Main Features[/heading]
[list]
[*]Rotating town events[/*]
[*]Custom Valley Alive board menu[/*]
[*]Town reputation progression[/*]
[*]Community Tokens currency[/*]
[*]Progressive Reward Shop with 300 reward entries[/*]
[*]Reputation-based shop unlocks[/*]
[*]Event badges[/*]
[*]Event history[/*]
[*]Event forecast tab[/*]
[*]Villager reactions tab[/*]
[*]Reward preview and progress tracking[/*]
[*]Custom Valley Alive and Reward Shop headers[/*]
[*]Scrollable menus[/*]
[*]Controller support[/*]
[*]Mouse and keyboard support[/*]
[/list][heading]How To Open The Board[/heading]
Press:
[code]V[/code]This opens the Valley Alive board.
From the board you can view:
[list]
[*]Today’s event[/*]
[*]Reputation[/*]
[*]Badges[/*]
[*]History[/*]
[*]Forecast[/*]
[*]Reactions[/*]
[*]Reward Shop[/*]
[/list][heading]Community Events[/heading]
Each event shows useful information such as:
[list]
[*]Event name[/*]
[*]Location[/*]
[*]Status[/*]
[*]Objective[/*]
[*]Progress[/*]
[*]Deadline[/*]
[*]Reward preview[/*]
[/list]Complete events to earn rewards, town reputation, and Community Tokens.
[heading]Community Tokens[/heading]
Community Tokens are the main reward currency for Valley Alive.
You earn them by completing town events.
You spend them in the Reward Shop.
The shop does not use gold.
[heading]Reward Shop[/heading]
The Reward Shop contains 300 reward entries.
Rewards include:
[list]
[*]Seeds[/*]
[*]Crop bundles[/*]
[*]Farm resource bundles[/*]
[*]Mining supplies[/*]
[*]Ores and bars[/*]
[*]Geodes[/*]
[*]Gems[/*]
[*]Fish bundles[/*]
[*]Forage bundles[/*]
[*]Food bundles[/*]
[*]Warp totems[/*]
[*]Sprinklers[/*]
[*]Rare reward caches[/*]
[*]High-reputation premium rewards[/*]
[/list]More rewards unlock as your town reputation increases.
Locked rewards show their reputation requirement.
[heading]Reputation[/heading]
Town reputation increases when you complete Valley Alive events.
Higher reputation unlocks better Reward Shop items and gives you a sense of long-term progress as a trusted helper in Pelican Town.
[heading]Badges[/heading]
Valley Alive includes badge tracking for event milestones and long-term participation.
Badges can be viewed from the Valley Alive board.
[heading]Controller Support[/heading]
Valley Alive includes controller support for the custom board and Reward Shop.
Supported controls include:
[list]
[*]D-pad navigation[/*]
[*]Shoulder button navigation where applicable[/*]
[*]A button to open the shop or buy selected rewards[/*]
[*]B/Back to close custom menus[/*]
[*]Highlighted selected shop rows[/*]
[/list]Mouse and keyboard are also supported.
[heading]Installation[/heading]
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Download Valley Alive.[/*]
[*]Extract the
[code]ValleyAlive[/code]folder into your Stardew Valley
[code]Mods[/code]folder.[/*]
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI.[/*]
[/list]
[heading]Compatibility[/heading]
Valley Alive is a SMAPI mod.
It should work with most mods, but heavily modified item, event, or UI mods may affect balance or display.
[heading]Credits[/heading]
Created by [b]starzzz[/b].
Thank you to everyone who tests, reports issues, and helps make the valley feel more alive.

Manifest.Name: Valley Alive
Manifest.Description: Adds dynamic daily town events, a polished event board, world markers, Community Tokens, a progressive token-based Reward Shop with 300 clearly named entries, custom shop header, reputation levels, badges, event history, forecasts, event chains, seasonal/rare events, town moods, host friendship rewards, scrolling UI, and JSON content packs. Random marker events no longer claim to spawn vendors or merchants.
Manifest.Author: Leanne
